skills.name: Psychokinesis
skills.description: Gathers psycho energy in his hands to attack. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 2600% Area Damage  *Enemy ATK -40% (10 sec) *Cancels HP regen

skills.name: Ekubo Possession
skills.description: Ekubo possesses Ritsu, awakening his powers. Good effects on allies.  *Area Physical DEF +28000 (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +50% (7 sec) *Skill Resistance +50% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Mob
abilities.description: Mob Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Persistence
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability have a high chance of activating Persistence when defeated. Persistence allows these Rangers to hold on for 7 more seconds with a big ATK increase.
